name: extension
description: Encrypted developer chat inside VS Code

commands.title: Dev Chat: Host Relay on This Network

devChat.relayUrl.patternErrorMessage: Relay URL must start with ws:// or wss://
devChat.relayUrl.markdownDescription: WebSocket address of the relay to connect to, for example `ws://192.168.1.20:8787`. Ask the person hosting the relay on your network for this address. Ignored while you are hosting a relay with **Dev Chat: Host Relay on This Network**.

devChat.hostRelay.port.markdownDescription: Port used by **Dev Chat: Host Relay on This Network**. Change it if another program already uses the default port.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm --prefix ../server run build && node --test
